title: Joel Gascoigne (Buffer founder) on X — 'A big day. I'm excited for all the long term companies you're going to help'
summary: Buffer founder Joel Gascoigne — one of the original transparent / long-term company founders — marks the launch with a short note about why the book matters.
blockquote: A big day. I'm excited for all the long term companies you're going to help. We need more of them around.
